channel.description: Alertas de vulnerabilidade (CVSS) - fonte NVD (fallback quando o SecurityWizardry está bloqueado) - RMFconsultoria

item.title: CVE-2026-134442 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1 | Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in ldap-client/popup_browser.cgi that allows attackers to inject markup by storing it in LDAP attribute values printed without HTML encoding. Attackers with write access to an LDAP directory entry, needing no Webmin account, can execute scripts in the Webmin origin when an administrator browses that entry.

item.title: CVE-2026-134444 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3 | Webmin through 2.670 contains a cleartext transmission vulnerability in connect_ldap_db in ldap-server/ldap-server-lib.pl that sends the LDAP root DN password unencrypted when encryption is set to Detect automatically. Passive network attackers observing traffic between Webmin and a remote LDAP server can capture directory root credentials because the connection loop always reaches a plaintext bind attempt.

item.title: CVE-2026-134445 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.3
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.3 | Webmin through 2.670 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in status/edit_mon.cgi that allows attackers to inject scripts through unescaped monitor status descriptions. Malicious HTTP or FTPS server operators, on-path attackers, or local users creating crafted filenames in wildcard-monitored directories can execute JavaScript in a Webmin user's session.

item.title: CVE-2026-134446 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3 | Webmin through 2.670 contains a weak random password generation vulnerability in generate_random_password() that allows attackers to predict generated account passwords because seed_random() effectively seeds Perl rand() with only time XOR process ID. When the non-default random_password option is enabled and administrators keep the pre-filled password in edit_user.cgi, attackers can enumerate time and PID seeds to recover passwords and authenticate as new accounts.

item.title: CVE-2026-134447 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.3 | Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in postfix/view_mailq.cgi and sendmail/view_mailq.cgi that allows unauthenticated attackers to inject script via unsanitized MIME attachment filenames. Attackers can send a message with a crafted Content-Disposition or Content-Type filename that remains queued, executing script in the Webmin session of users viewing it.

item.title: CVE-2026-134462 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.3
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.3 | Webmin through 2.670 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in mount/nfs_export.cgi that allows malicious NFS servers to inject scripts through unescaped export paths. Attackers controlling or spoofing an NFS server's mountd replies can return crafted export paths that execute JavaScript in the session of a Webmin user browsing exports.

item.title: CVE-2026-134463 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3 | Webmin through 2.670 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in switch_smtp_to_ssl in mailboxes/boxes-lib.pl and status/smtp-monitor.pl, which calls Net::SSLeay::connect without certificate verification or a hostname check. Man-in-the-middle attackers can present any certificate when SMTP with SSL or STARTTLS is configured to capture SMTP AUTH credentials and message content.

item.title: CVE-2026-134627 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 5.1 | Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows local users or directory writers to inject script by placing markup in user names, group names or GECOS fields. Attackers can set GECOS via chfn or modify LDAP, NIS or SSSD entries so unescaped values in my_user_chooser.cgi, my_group_chooser.cgi, user_chooser.cgi and group_chooser.cgi execute in a Webmin user's browser.

item.title: CVE-2026-134628 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 4.8
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 4.8 | Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in the Disk Quotas module that allows directory administrators to inject markup via NSS user names. Attackers who can create or rename LDAP, NIS or SSSD identities owning blocks on XFS quota filesystems can execute script in the browser of administrators viewing quota/list_users.cgi.

item.title: CVE-2026-134629 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.3
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.3 | Webmin through 2.670 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in mysql/index.cgi that renders MySQL connection error text and server version strings without escaping. Malicious MySQL server operators or on-path attackers on plaintext connections can return markup in error packets or version strings to execute JavaScript in Webmin user sessions.

item.title: CVE-2026-134630 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.7
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.7 | Webmin through 2.670 contains a remote code execution vulnerability in the Perl Modules (cpan) module, which downloads CPAN indexes and module archives over plaintext HTTP without checksum or signature verification. On-path network attackers can answer the outbound fetch while an administrator installs a CPAN module, supplying a malicious Makefile.PL that cpan/download.cgi runs as root before confirmation.

item.title: CVE-2026-134631 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 4.8
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 4.8 | Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in ldap-useradmin/edit_user.cgi that allows attackers to inject markup through the LDAP sambaAcctFlags and sambaBadPasswordCount attributes, which are rendered without HTML encoding. Attackers with LDAP write access to these attributes can store malicious scripts that execute in a Webmin administrator's browser when the user entry is opened in the editor.

item.title: CVE-2026-134632 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.0
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.0 | Webmin through 2.670 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability that allows man-in-the-middle attackers to capture credentials because servers/save_serv.cgi skips the selected SSL certificate check. When fast RPC is set to Automatic, attackers intercepting the /fastrpc.cgi probe can obtain the remote Webmin username and password sent via HTTP Basic Authorization.

item.title: CVE-2026-134633 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.3
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.3 | Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in init/mass_systemd.cgi that prints unescaped journalctl output when a systemd service fails to start. Attackers can inject script into the journal via logger or sshd invalid user names, executing it in an administrator's Webmin session.

item.title: CVE-2026-134634 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.0
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.0 | Webmin through 2.670 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in servers/link.cgi that accepts self-signed certificates for linked servers even when certificate checking is enabled. Man-in-the-middle attackers presenting a self-signed certificate with the correct hostname can capture stored HTTP Basic credentials for the remote Webmin and inject HTML into the local Webmin origin.

item.title: CVE-2026-134635 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.3
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.3 | Webmin through 2.670 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in ldap-client/check.cgi that allows LDAP directory writers to execute commands via unquoted uid values. Attackers can create a posixAccount entry with shell metacharacters in its uid, executing commands as root when an administrator runs Check Configuration.

item.title: CVE-2026-134636 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3 | Webmin through 2.670 contains a weak randomness vulnerability that allows attackers to predict TOTP two-factor secrets generated by generate_base32_secret() using a time and PID seeded rand(). Attackers who know a user's password and estimate enrollment time can enumerate candidate seeds, reproduce the secret, and bypass the second authentication factor.

item.title: CVE-2026-134637 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3 | Webmin through 2.670 contains a STARTTLS downgrade vulnerability in send_mail in mailboxes/boxes-lib.pl that continues over plaintext when STARTTLS is rejected. Man-in-the-middle attackers can strip or reject STARTTLS to capture configured SMTP AUTH credentials, crackable CRAM-MD5 exchanges, and the content of sent mail.

item.title: CVE-2026-134638 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.7
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.7 | Webmin through 2.670 contains a missing integrity verification vulnerability in usermin/upgrade.cgi that downloads Usermin upgrade packages over plaintext HTTP without signature or digest checks. On-path network attackers or DNS spoofers can supply a malicious RPM, Debian, or tar.gz package whose maintainer scripts or setup.sh execute as root during upgrade.

item.title: CVE-2026-134639 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 9.2
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 9.2 | Webmin through 2.670 contains an insecure default configuration in its Windows setup.bat script that provisions an administrator account with the credentials admin/admin and SSL disabled. Unauthenticated network attackers can log in over plain HTTP on port 10000 with these unchanged credentials to gain full Webmin administrative access.

item.title: CVE-2026-134640 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3 | Webmin through 2.670 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in imap_login in mailboxes/folders-lib.pl that skips certificate verification and hostname checks for IMAP SSL connections. Man-in-the-middle attackers can present any certificate to capture IMAP credentials sent by the System and Server Status IMAP monitor and spoof monitor results.

item.title: CVE-2026-134641 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.4
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.4 | Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in minecraft/save_backup.cgi that allows local attackers with write access to the Minecraft server directory to inject script via unescaped world directory names. Attackers can create a world directory containing HTML or script that executes in a Webmin user's session when they run Backup Now.

item.title: CVE-2026-134642 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.7
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.7 | Webmin through 2.670 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in fastrpc.cgi that allows unauthenticated network peers to connect to tcpwrite and tcpread file-transfer listeners without session checks. Attackers can race to connect to the predictable transfer port during cluster operations to steal transferred files or replace staged packages, achieving root code execution.

item.title: CVE-2026-134643 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3 | Webmin through 2.670 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in password_change.cgi that allows unauthenticated attackers to change passwords for accounts with empty stored hashes. When passwd_mode is 2, attackers can POST user, old, new1 and new2 with any old value to set a known password and gain access.

item.title: CVE-2026-134644 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3 | Webmin through 2.670 contains a path traversal vulnerability in minecraft/minecraft-lib.pl that allows unauthenticated game players to overwrite arbitrary files as root via crafted chat messages. Attackers can send chat messages mimicking logged in lines so the root check_playtime_limits cron job rewrites attacker-chosen files, destroying their contents.

item.title: CVE-2026-134645 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.4
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.4 | Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in proc/trace.cgi that allows local unprivileged OS users to inject markup via unescaped process arguments and system call parameters. Attackers can craft process command lines or file names passed to open so that script executes in a Webmin user's session when they trace the process.

item.title: CVE-2026-134646 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.3 | Webmin through 2.670 contains a cleartext transmission vulnerability in the SMTP service monitor that never issues STARTTLS because get_smtp_status tests an undefined $ssl variable. Passive network attackers can capture AUTH PLAIN credentials sent in plaintext each time a STARTTLS-configured monitor runs, without needing a Webmin login.

item.title: CVE-2026-134647 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 7.7
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 7.7 | Webmin through 2.670 contains a cleartext transmission vulnerability in web-lib-funcs.pl and fastrpc.cgi that sends cluster RPC traffic over raw TCP despite SSL configuration. Network-positioned attackers can read the session ID and remote_eval payloads or alter calls in transit to execute code as root on managed servers.

item.title: CVE-2026-134648 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 6.3 | Webmin through 2.670 contains a header directive injection vulnerability in sendmail/autoreply.pl that allows unauthenticated mail senders to inject autoreply directives by placing them in inbound subject, from, date, or body fields. Attackers can inject Reply-Tracking to delete files at chosen paths, Autoreply-File to exfiltrate files readable by the delivery user, or arbitrary reply headers including To.

item.title: CVE-2026-134649 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 1.0
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 1.0 | Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in logrotate/force.cgi that prints logrotate -f diagnostic output without HTML escaping. Local OS users can create files with script-laden names in wildcard-rotated log directories, executing script in the Webmin session when Force Log Rotation is clicked.

item.title: CVE-2026-134650 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 2.0
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 2.0 | Webmin through 2.670 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in useradmin/edit_user.cgi that displays home directory paths without HTML escaping to users with the autohome ACL. A Webmin user with broader Users and Groups rights can store a home path containing script via save_user.cgi, executing it in a restricted sub-administrator's Webmin session.

item.title: CVE-2026-118898 - NVD - CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7
item.description:
Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v4.0: 8.7 | Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in lasp-lang partisan allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to abort the Erlang VM of a node via Excessive Allocation. partisan_peer_service_server:handle_info/2 decodes every frame that arrives on the peer listener with binary_to_term/1, without the safe option, before handle_inbound/2 interprets the message and before any peer authentication takes place. TLS is off by default and the listener accepts connections from any host, so one frame that names more atoms than the atom table holds aborts the VM. partisan_peer_service_client:handle_info/2 decodes frames from the server side of a connection the same way.
The decode also materializes funs, ports and references the frame encodes and inflates compressed terms. The demonstrated impact is denial of service. partisan does not invoke decoded funs, so code execution was not shown.
This issue affects partisan: from 3.0.0 before 6.4.0.

item.title: CVE-2026-130336 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 7.5
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 7.5 | Improper Neutralization of Directives in Dynamically Evaluated Code ('Eval Injection') in the HWBridge custom methods command dispatcher (lib/rex/post/hwbridge/ui/console/command_dispatcher/custom_methods.rb) in Rapid7 Metasploit Framework versions prior to 6.5.10 on all platforms allows a malicious or compromised hardware bridge to execute arbitrary code in the msfconsole process via a crafted method_name returned by the /custom_methods endpoint. The injected code runs automatically when the operator connects to the bridge, without the operator invoking any custom command.

item.title: CVE-2026-132145 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 5.9
item.description: Wednesday 25 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 5.9 | A flaw was found in rsyslog. When using the Datagram Transport Layer Security (DTLS) output module (omdtls) configured to authenticate receivers by name or fingerprint, the module validates the certificate chain against trusted certificate authorities but fails to verify that the certificate matches the intended receiver's identity or fingerprint. An attacker who can redirect or intercept outbound network traffic and present a certificate issued by a trusted certificate authority could capture forwarded log data, leading to information disclosure.
